in_hindi.name: चन्दिनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Chandini' is derived from the word 'Chandra' which means moon in Sanskrit and 'ini' is a suffix that means one who is adorned with or one who brings. So, Chandini means 'The one who is adorned with the moon or the one who brings the moon'.

vedic_reference.note: Chandini is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Chandra' which means moon in Sanskrit. In Hindu mythology, Chandini is an epithet of the moon god Chandra and is also the name of a celestial nymph who is the personification of the moon.
